_comment: Resource markers: marks whose first argument is a requirement, not a condition.
'description' the line `defs/pytest.ini` declares the marker with, copied byte
'bounds'      the machine fact the requirement is compared with: gpus,
device_memory_mib or device_name. null: not evaluated.
'read'        how `defs/conftest.py` looks the marker up: closest
`skip_less_mpi_world_size` bounds gpus: one rank per GPU.

skip_less_device.description: skip when less device detected than the declared

skip_less_mpi_world_size.description: skip when less mpi world size detected than the declared

skip_less_device_memory.description: skip when less device memory detected than the requested

skip_less_host_memory.description: skip when less host memory detected than the requested

skip_device_not_contain.description: skip when the device does not contain the specified keyword
